predecessors.name: Allied-occupied Germany
predecessors.text: the Saar, 'disentangled from the Allied zones of occupation' by France on 16 February 1946, with 109 municipalities of the Prussian Rhine Province added from 20 July 1946

successors.name: Federal Republic of Germany (West Germany)
successors.text: Saarland, which 'joined the Federal Republic of Germany as a state on 1 January 1957'

ledger.x: 16 February 1946: France separates the Saar from the Allied zones.
16 February 1946: the Saar becomes a French protectorate.
20 July 1946: 109 municipalities are added to the Saar.
From 8 June 1947 to 1949: 13 more municipalities are ceded to the Saar by Rhineland-Palatinate.
15 December 1947: the Saar is constituted as the Saarland.
1 January 1957: the protectorate ends as the Saar 'became a state of West Germany (as Saarland) on 1 January 1957'.
1 January 1957: the Saar joins West Germany.

certainty.note: Municipal boundaries fixed by decree (20 July 1946) and exchanged in 1947-49; the pages give no coordinates, so the cells follow today's Saarland border.
